```{julia}
#| echo: false
include(joinpath(@__DIR__, "benchmarks", "benchmarks.jl"))
using NeuroTabModels.Models
using CairoMakie
# `device: gpu` needs CUDA and cuDNN in the quarto environment
device == "gpu" && @eval using CUDA, cuDNN
```

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
println("# Benchmark: ", dataset, "\n\n", DATASETS[dataset].description)
```

This report fits each architecture on the same data with the same settings, then scores it on a held-out test set. Running it adds its results to `quarto/benchmarks/results.csv`, which feeds the [benchmark summary](benchmarks.md).

## Data

The data is split 70/15/15 into train, eval and test sets. Features are standardised with the train mean and std. The eval set drives early stopping, and the test set is only used for the final scores.

```{julia}
data = load_benchmark(dataset)
(; spec, dtrain, deval, dtest, feature_names, target_name) = data
(; task=spec.task, train=nrow(dtrain), eval=nrow(deval), test=nrow(dtest), features=length(feature_names))
```

## Models

Each architecture is close to its defaults, and training uses the package defaults (learning rate, loss for the task) apart from the number of rounds, the batch size and early stopping.

```{julia}
#| output: false
archs = [
    "MLP" => MLPConfig(; hidden_size=64, stack_size=2),
    "ResNet" => ResNetConfig(; hidden_size=64, stack_size=2),
    "NeuroTree" => NeuroTreeConfig(; depth=4, ntrees=32),
    "TabM" => TabMConfig(; k=8, d_block=128, n_blocks=2),
]
settings = (; nrounds=spec.nrounds, batchsize=spec.batchsize, early_stopping_rounds=20, device=Symbol(device))
```

## Training

Each model is fitted once for one round first, so the timings below leave out compilation.

```{julia}
#| output: false
models, rows = Dict{String,Any}(), DataFrame()
info = run_info()
for (name, arch) in archs
    config = learner(spec.task, arch; settings...)
    warmup = learner(spec.task, arch; settings..., nrounds=1)
    NeuroTabModels.fit(warmup, dtrain; feature_names, target_name, deval, verbosity=0)

    train_time = @elapsed m = NeuroTabModels.fit(config, dtrain; feature_names, target_name, deval, verbosity=0)
    m(dtest)
    predict_time = @elapsed p = m(dtest)
    models[name] = m

    metrics = vcat(
        test_metrics(spec.task, p, dtest[!, target_name]),
        [
            "best_iter" => m.info[:logger][:best_iter],
            "train_time" => train_time,
            # early stopping sets the number of rounds, so speed is compared per round
            "time_per_round" => train_time / max(m.info[:logger][:nrounds], 1),
            "predict_time" => predict_time,
        ],
    )
    for (metric, value) in metrics
        push!(rows, (; info..., device, dataset, model=name, metric, value=Float64(value)))
    end
end
record_results(rows)
```

## Results

Test-set scores, and training (in total and per round) and prediction times in seconds.

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
wide = unstack(rows, :model, :metric, :value)
println(pretty_table(String, wide; backend=:markdown, column_labels=names(wide)))
```


## Learning curves

The eval metric at each round. Training stops after 20 rounds without improvement.

```{julia}
#| echo: false
fig = Figure(; size=(720, 420))
ax = Axis(fig[1, 1]; xlabel="round", ylabel=first(values(models)).info[:logger][:name])
for (name, _) in archs
    logger = models[name].info[:logger]
    lines!(ax, logger[:metrics][:iter], logger[:metrics][:metric]; label=name)
end
axislegend(ax; position=:rt)
fig
```
